scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the function hook off vs candidate with the hook on), 2816 isolated CPU pairs for the 4 pending functions of CBike, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored and layout_ok, layout event ok, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture in both legs and compares the resulting state, the x87 control word (24 bits) and the whole trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments; foreign threads ignored. Limits: no NaN in matrices or velocity, handlingId 0..209, entities with non-null matrix and collision; CEventKnockOffBike and CEventGroup::Add are fakes (traced). The bank EvId lookup was fixed to search from the last to the first match (the DLL reuses the stack slot for the driver/passenger events) and it keeps up to 8 failures with raw trace. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (Bike.cpp and Bike.h match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Revalidado el 2026-10-26 tras reconstruir colaboradores (lote 67 y anteriores); el banco se adapto a ellos (ver su README.md).
